scope.statement: This catalog records repository evidence and possible adapter roles. It is a local-read plan, not a build, rewrite, installation, execution, or deployment.

open_door.statement: Descriptors report compatibility without deciding who or what may participate.

frameworks.name: inception-core
observed_primitives: In-memory, file, and RocksDB storage implementations
Optional gRPC and WebSocket service surfaces
unsupported_or_incomplete_claims: Raft consensus was not found
BLAKE3 audit trails were not found
WebAssembly execution was not found
Capability-policy enforcement was not found
Verifiable replay was not found
gRPC methods are placeholders and the WebSocket path is an echo service
maturity_signals: Repository size observed at approximately 39 KB

frameworks.name: multi-agent-engine
unsupported_or_incomplete_claims: The GPU crate is effectively empty and contains no verified backend
GPU acceleration was not implemented at the verified revision
SIMD execution was not implemented at the verified revision
Large-population performance statements are design claims rather than repository evidence

frameworks.name: AutoAgents
unsupported_or_incomplete_claims: Standard A2A protocol support was not verified
The inspected Wasmtime runtime did not expose explicit fuel, epoch, or memory limits
Open security issue 288 reports that the Google backend can expose an API key in an error URL
maturity_signals: Head CI, build, full-test, and WASI checks passed at verification time

frameworks.name: swarms-rs
observed_primitives: Sequential, concurrent, and graph workflow types
MCP stdio and SSE transports through rmcp
unsupported_or_incomplete_claims: A2A support was not found
Raft support was not found
WebAssembly execution was not found
No independent performance evidence was found
maturity_signals: README license text says MIT while the repository license is Apache-2.0
Scheduled CI, documentation, security, Miri, license, and supply-chain checks were failing on 2026-08-25 and 2026-08-26

frameworks.name: GraphBit
unsupported_or_incomplete_claims: MCP support was not found
A2A support was not found
WebAssembly execution was not found
GPU execution was not found
Durable checkpoint recovery was not found
Published performance statements were self-reported and were not independently verified

frameworks.name: Sayiir
observed_primitives: PostgreSQL-backed distributed workers and task claims
Rust, Python, Node, and Cloudflare bindings
unsupported_or_incomplete_claims: This is a durable workflow engine rather than an LLM-agent orchestrator
MCP support was not found
A2A support was not found
Raft support was not found
Sandboxed tool execution was not found
The enterprise server is planned
External side effects still require application-level idempotency

frameworks.name: Microsoft Agent Framework for Go
unsupported_or_incomplete_claims: Public-preview status
Handoffs were not implemented in the Go surface at verification time
Declarative agents were not implemented in the Go surface at verification time
RAG and CodeAct were not implemented in the Go surface at verification time
Functional workflows were not implemented in the Go surface at verification time
Foundry-hosted deployment was not implemented in the Go surface at verification time
Raft, WebAssembly, GPU, and bare-metal performance claims were not verified
maturity_signals: Head tests, lint, and CodeQL checks passed at verification time
Public preview rather than a stable production release

frameworks.name: AOF Agentic DevOps Framework
observed_primitives: YAML-first Agent, Fleet, and AgentFlow descriptions
MCP stdio, SSE, and HTTP transports
unsupported_or_incomplete_claims: NATS and Redis horizontal queues are explicitly planned rather than implemented
A NoOps compiler was not found
Runtime and component implementation is partial
maturity_signals: Project documentation reports approximately 80 percent completion
Head build and integration checks were failing at verification time
Latest verified head included removal of hard-coded Slack tokens

Encryption and authentication were not found
Persistence was not found
Consensus was not found
Delivery guarantees were not found
Peer-loss detection is timeout-based rather than instantaneous

misattribution_corrections.claim_family: Raft, BLAKE3, WebAssembly, capability-safe execution, and verifiable audit or replay
misattribution_corrections.correction: Those claims were not found in inception-core. Their wording and dependency evidence align with cathedral.fabric, which remains an unverified lab candidate rather than an endorsed implementation.

misattribution_corrections.claim_family: NoOps DSL, multi-language generation, NATS, and Kubernetes generation
misattribution_corrections.correction: Those claims were not found in AOF. Their wording aligns with kumeo, which remains an unverified reference candidate rather than an endorsed implementation.

unverified_candidates.name: cathedral.fabric
observed_repository_signals: Workspace dependency declarations include BLAKE3, OpenRaft, and Wasmtime
GitHub license detection reported Apache-2.0 while workspace metadata permits MIT OR Apache-2.0
limitations: Created and last pushed on the same verified date
Dependency presence alone does not prove every reported behavior

unverified_candidates.name: kumeo
observed_repository_signals: Repository descriptions align with the NoOps, code-generation, NATS, and Kubernetes claim family
limitations: No later activity was observed after the verified head date
GPL-3.0-or-later licensing requires separate compatibility review before any reuse
